metadata.title: Production-harden jira sync command
metadata.description: Fix flag handling and exit codes in 'pm jira sync' so preview mode is honored, --max-results works, and failures exit non-zero.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: jira sync threw plain Error (no exitCode) → runtime double-invocation
metadata.description: jira sync (and the jira-sync importer) threw plain Error on missing env/args and fetch failure; pm re-invokes the handler on the unhandled path. Added CommandError mirroring SDK EXIT_CODE; missing-env/args=2, fetch-failure=1; single invocation.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed: CommandError carries exitCode. Verified missing-env/args exit 2, fetch-failure exits 1, single invocation; 7 tests pass.

metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: sync failures return {success:false} instead of throwing -> exit code 0
metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: Failures exited 0 (missing creds / no project / fetch error)
metadata.description: Three paths returned { success:false, error }, which the runtime treats as success (exit 0). Switched to throwing so the CLI exits non-zero; also fail when every create fails.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: --dry-run silently wrote items instead of previewing
metadata.description: Flag read as ctx.options['dry-run'] but runtime normalizes to camelCase 'dryRun'; dry-run was always false so 'preview' created real pm items. Now reads both keys via optionEnabled().
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: --max-results ignored (always 500)
metadata.description: Read as ctx.options['max-results'] (runtime uses 'maxResults') and never coerced from string. Now read via optionInt() across both keys with integer coercion.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed, tested (7 unit tests) and verified exit codes end-to-end.

metadata.title: ci: fix release workflow step ordering
metadata.description: Swap changelog regeneration before release:check so changelog:check sees the version-bumped CHANGELOG.md instead of failing the gate.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Swapped changelog generation before release checks so changelog:check sees updated file. Verified workflow dispatch then triggers npm publish + GH release.

metadata.title: Release readiness hardening for pm-jira
metadata.description: Prepare pm-jira as a production-ready pm package with package-local pm tracking, generated changelog data, CI and daily release automation.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.acceptance_criteria: Package installs with pm install; npm release gate passes; changelog is generated from package-local pm data; tracked files and reachable git history have no secret pattern hits.

metadata.title: Add bun-install verification to release workflow
metadata.description: Smoke-test that the just-published npm package installs cleanly via bun via daily release workflow.
metadata.author: codex

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.
metadata.author: codex
